examples.hook: The morning you least want to pray is the one that needs it most.
examples.caption: Before the noise starts, there is a quiet minute that belongs to you. Take it. "Be still, and know that I am God." (Psalm 46:10)
examples.what_works: Names a real feeling, grounds it in scripture, invites without pressure

gold_posts.hook: If you woke up already behind, start here.
gold_posts.caption: Anxiety loves an empty morning. Give it a verse instead. "Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you." (1 Peter 5:7) Breathe. Begin again.
